verdicts.reason: A keeps the red 'LONGEST DAY SALE' ribbon prominent, but it is jammed into the top-left corner and doesn't line up with the logo on the right. The headline wraps to leave an orphaned 'last'. The fine print is enlarged and crammed between the subhead and an oversized CTA, leaving the bottom fifth empty. B shrinks the sale ribbon to a tiny, barely legible tag stuck below the CTA, which destroys the original hierarchy and buries the key offer. It has the same orphaned 'last', fine print wedged above the CTA, and a lot of dead space around the bottle.
